attributes.name: price text styling
attributes.definition: Visual emphasis (weight and colour) applied to the current/sale price text.

values.definition: Current price is bold and set in an accent or brand colour (e.g. green).
Price uses regular weight and default text colour.
No statement about current price styling.

attributes.name: original price treatment
attributes.definition: How a previous/original price is shown alongside the current price.

values.definition: Original price has a line-through and a muted/grey colour.
Original price has a line-through, with no stated colour change.

attributes.name: strikethrough markup
attributes.definition: HTML element used to mark struck-through text.

values.definition: Line-through applied via CSS on a generic element.

attributes.name: variable price prefix
attributes.definition: Whether prices with variants are labelled with a prefix such as 'from'.

values.definition: Prices shown plainly without a prefix.
